name: uOS27
description: Native Lomiri/Qt Quick shell redesign for the Samsung Galaxy S10+ Ubuntu Touch port
last_handset_appearance_result: Status bar and overall design accepted by tester. Later tester update: brightness now appears to work; Bluetooth still fails to power on. No integrated RC3 handset trial yet.

implemented_shell_surfaces: live LauncherModel Home and horizontal pages
native four-icon dock and searchable app Drawer
native Greeter visual skin and original PIN controls
approved status/camera cutout and app header tint
Control Center and native notifications with matching dark scrim
native Bluetooth/Wi-Fi/cellular and system detail pages
brightness and volume gestures without visual percentage labels
Launcher, Spread task switcher and native popup/dialog skins
candidate.radio_bridge: org.uos27.Control short-lived Gio SimpleAction exports live BlueZ Adapter1.Powered and accepts typed boolean requests as phablet, not root
candidate.session_only_readback_trace: BlueZ power, Ayatana brightness action and raw panel brightness/actual_brightness/max_brightness, no addresses or notification content
candidate.handset_test_result: Blocked before authentication: user reports original sideways unlock swipe and no visible PIN-entry keypad. Other shell functions could not be evaluated.
candidate.greeter_failure_status: Confirmed visual/interaction blocker from user report; runtime QML logs not yet available, exact missing PIN cause undetermined
candidate.greeter_source_review: CoverPage DragHandle remains Direction.Horizontal; added bottom unlock pill is decorative only. Prior isolated Qt5 PIN-button test did not exercise GreeterView, LightDM prompt display or an unlock gesture.
candidate.rollback_result: Not yet independently confirmed for the integrated trial

corrective_candidate.corrects: 0.10-rc1 handset lock-screen blocker: native horizontal swipe and no PIN keyboard
corrective_candidate.user_reported_recovery: Original interface returned to normal after stopping the first trial
corrective_candidate.status: Host-built and regression-tested; device overlay not yet executed
corrective_candidate.phone_portrait_unlock: Real upward-swipe/tap QML MouseArea dispatches GreeterView.tryToUnlock(false); disabled horizontal DragHandle; desktop/tablet unchanged
corrective_candidate.native_pin_prompt: GlassPinPrompt embeds stock PinLockscreen; GreeterPrompt and PromptList still transport the result to the original LightDM service; no credentials or PAM logic changed

full_greeter_host_flow.scope: Real Qt5 gesture + native PinLockscreen + original GreeterPrompt/PromptList glue, with mocked LightDM model/services

corrective_candidate.next_step: One guarded handset integrated trial after read-only preflight and independent recovery access; PIN is first pass/fail gate

integrated_cover_candidate.reason: RC2 preserved a separate native login surface; the tester requires the PIN keypad integrated into the visible lock-screen cover and a visibly revised Control Center
integrated_cover_candidate.front_cover_greeter_reparenting: The existing LoginList is placed on the front CoverPage for portrait one-user numeric PIN instead of revealing a separate native login page; password and multi-user cases retain stock routes
integrated_cover_candidate.authentication: Original GreeterPrompt/LightDM response path, unchanged PAM and stored PIN
integrated_cover_candidate.radio_bridge: Records sanitized D-Bus error name from BlueZ Adapter1.Powered write failure, without device addresses or pairing data
integrated_cover_candidate.tester_brightness_update: Appears to work in latest observed UI revision; no RC3 hardware readback
integrated_cover_candidate.next_gate: One read-only preflight followed by one integrated 600-second phone trial, with PIN unlock first and rollback attestation after

installed_app_dashboard_candidate.state: development candidate, source staged on host, no handset trial
installed_app_dashboard_candidate.home_model: Native AppDrawerModel and AppDrawerProxyModel instead of LauncherModel; installed unpinned app icons appear on pages and in integrated search
installed_app_dashboard_candidate.dock_model: Native LauncherModel, first four pinned applications
installed_app_dashboard_candidate.left_rail: Hidden in unlocked phone session only; desktop and greeter retain stock launcher
installed_app_dashboard_candidate.bottom_home_gesture: SwipeArea Upwards center-bottom, gated against lockscreen, modal dialogs, panel and OSK
installed_app_dashboard_candidate.pin_path_kept: Original GreeterView/LoginList/LightDM input and original authentication flow, Qt5 fixtures only

keyboard_theme.read_only_source_inventory: scripts/uos27_native_inventory.py: three pinned upstream hashes, theme-name collision detection, official package versions; no installation
keyboard_theme.changes: QML style reference, key radius/font spacing and palette JSON; no key event dispatch rewritten

installed_app_dashboard_candidate.next_gate: One integrated phone trial only after the native components have a safe deployment and rollback plan; RC4 shell-only is not a full native system redesign

combined_native_preparation_candidate.bluetooth_action_approach: First activate the native Ayatana bluetooth-enabled boolean GAction, then re-read BlueZ; only if needed fall back to the unprivileged Adapter1.Powered property Set, never publish optimistic state
combined_native_preparation_candidate.bluetooth_trace_rfkill_details: Read-only Bluetooth soft/hard block flags only; no rfkill ID, adapter address, device names, pairing or input contents
remaining_gates: Exact installed keyboard tree readback and cross-check
Compatible ARM64 Qt/UBports Settings package build, audit and safe reversible activation

hardware_cause_hypotheses.bluetooth: Ayatana indicator action may only manipulate rfkill when a killswitch exists, while BlueZ Adapter1 Powered remains off; unverified for installed S10+ service
hardware_cause_hypotheses.brightness: Ayatana brightness initial action state 1.0 differs from the sysfs actual_brightness 800/max_brightness 48600; values may have different semantics/scales, so no percentage inference
hardware_cause_hypotheses.changes: BlueZ power ON only if initially OFF and rfkill known unblocked; BlueZ power OFF in finally, report verification
